name: Gimbal
author: Erin Carter
description: Three nested gyroscope rings tumble in implied 3D, each a circle projected to a luminous phosphor ellipse brighter on its near side. Where two rings cross, a glint blooms; the dance closes seamlessly over a long loop.

params.label: Tumble speed
params.effect: Scales all three ring rotation rates together, from a near-still instrument slowly reorienting to a lively spinning gyroscope.

params.label: Radius
params.effect: Radius of the outermost ring in CSS pixels, scaling the whole nested assembly from a centred ornament to a frame-filling armature.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Brightness of the blooms where ring projections intersect — clean unadorned ellipses at 0, jewel-like sparks at every crossing at max.
